viator_experiences.title: Scottish Whisky Distilleries Tour: Lowlands & Highlands
viator_experiences.summary: Travel from Glasgow to three different distilleries and learn what it takes to craft a perfect-tasting whisky. You will visit a combination of…
viator_experiences.description_md: Travel from Glasgow to three different distilleries and learn what it takes to craft a perfect-tasting whisky. You will visit a combination of distilleries in the Highlands or Lowlands regions of Scotland, where luxury spirits are made using local barley and spring water. At each of the three famous distilleries you can taste a range of whiskies alongside local shortbread, all included in the price. A knowledgeable local driver provides commentary en route, sharing stories about the history of Scotland's national drink. The full-day tour also includes lunch, distillery entry fees and gratuities, with pick-up available from Glasgow.

viator_experiences.title: Glasgow City Centre Whisky Tour
viator_experiences.summary: Scotch whisky is renowned around the world, and Glasgow is home to some of Scotland's best whisky bars and pubs. On this small-group tour, you visit up to…
viator_experiences.description_md: Scotch whisky is renowned around the world, and Glasgow is home to some of Scotland's best whisky bars and pubs. On this small-group tour, you visit up to four different Glasgow bars, sample a variety of single malt whiskies, and learn about whisky-making, popular Scottish distilleries, and Glasgow's drinking culture. An expert whisky ambassador leads a guided tasting of five premium single malts, two of them very rare, alongside bottled water. The intimate group size ensures a relaxed and personal tasting experience, with the tour beginning at Mharsanta Scottish Restaurant & Bar in the city centre.

viator_experiences.description_md: This three-hour walking food tour with EatWalk Tours explores Glasgow's Merchant City, pairing locally sourced Scottish food and drink with the city's history. Guests are led between a selection of well-chosen establishments, sampling around four dishes along with accompanying drinks. A knowledgeable local host shares stories about Glasgow and its culinary scene throughout the walk. Groups are kept small, with a maximum of ten travellers, for an intimate experience, and the meals are included in the price.
